text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
Intensive training to improve skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Current temperature: 28 degrees. Relative humidity: 78%.
It can be classified as an average 'summer day' for July.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Even harsher heat is expected ahead.
Please take extra care to prevent heatstroke."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Master.
Let us both make sure to hydrate regularly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: And so, here's some refreshments for you.

—And Mihono Bourbon pulled a canteen
out from somewhere and handed it to me.

—A passionate summer training camp
with Mihono Bourbon had begun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
......
Once summer ends, it's the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Rice, hang in there... Oh-!
